item.title: Version 0.1.0 (Build 1)
item.description:
• Initial public release.
  • - Native macOS terminal workbench: Ghostty core (libghostty), real AppKit chrome
  • - Sessions outlive the app via goty-sessiond (Rust) — quit, crash, or reboot; shells keep running
  • - Servers from ~/.ssh/config, each with its own remote daemon and parked sessions
  • - Agent awareness: Claude Code, Codex & co. — brand icons, live status, git context
  • - @ai inline card: streaming markdown, executable bash/write/edit proposals
  • - Themed by your own Ghostty config; Sparkle auto-updates
